title: Morning Brief, Mon 16 Nov 2026: IMD NB5 (02:30 IST) says the Bay system became a deep depression at 23:30 IST 15 Nov, 870 km SSE of Visakhapatnam; cyclonic storm likely by 16 Nov evening, severe by 17 Nov evening, then NW towards the AP coast; along/off AP coast 120-130 gusting 145 km/h from 19 Nov evening to 20 Nov morning; no landfall point named; fishermen out of central Bay 16-20 Nov (lead). PM Modi to Manila for the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and EAS on 17 Nov, MEA would not say if he meets Trump; Goyal says India gets preferential US access with lower duties than rivals; India wants the AITIGA review done sooner. Kaziranga crash (13 Nov): 26 killed, minibus owner arrested, police say speed limiter on record but missing, 12 earlier violations; Assam steps up speed-limiter checks. ICC Board (Bali, 15 Nov) fixes event dates to 2035: India hosts 2029 Champions Trophy 9-28 Oct; India-Bangladesh 2031 World Cup 9 Oct-23 Nov. Yemen: Houthis ~60 km from Aden (AFP); government-allied forces quit Bab el-Mandeb to defend Aden.
